messages:
Ana L.: Quick sync — finalizing the Voyager impact story assets. We recorded the customer interview yesterday. Need: transcript sign-off, one approved pull-quote, legal clearance on name + logos, and final screenshots for the blog. Planning blog + 30-min webinar excerpt for next Wed. Can we get approvals by Friday EOD?

Julie C.: Sounds good. I can draft the blog outline today and prep the webinar page. Who's the primary speaker from Voyager?

Ana L.: Voyager will have Maya (product) + Raj (CTO) on the clip. Maya agreed to a quick soundbite we can use as the hero quote.

Carla (Legal): I skimmed the recording. Two quick asks: (1) redact any internal KPI numbers they accidentally mentioned, (2) we need written permission for using the Voyager logo in marketing. I left inline comments in the draft doc.

Ana L.: Thanks Carla — linking the draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/marketing/voyager-raw-transcript (transcript + draft quote selections are there). Please add the short permission text we can send to the customer.

Carla (Legal): Added a one-paragraph release. Text snippet: "Redwood may use the customer's name, logo, and provided comments for marketing and promotional purposes." Please confirm customer contact to route it.

Sam P.: For lead routing — once published, can we gate the webinar on a short form and route leads tagged 'Voyager-Story' to AE West (me + team)? Also want a single-sentence summary for SDRs.

Mike G.: Landing page + form ok. HubSpot form id: hs_4321. I'll set up a workflow that tags leads with 'source: voyager_story' and assigns to Sam's queue. Any specific UTM to use?

Sam P.: Use utm_campaign=voyager_story_2026, utm_medium=organic. Summary for SDRs: "Voyager reduced inference cost by ~40% with Redwood's dedicated pools — prospect uses Redwood for production LLM serving." Keep it short.

Julie C.: Draft blog timeline: Mon — final copy + screenshots, Tue — legal sign-off and customer signature on release, Wed — publish AM + webinar excerpt at 11am PT. Is that still ok?

Ana L.: That works. Carla, can we get the signed release by Tue EOD? Ran the quote choices by Maya; she prefers the shorter technical quote we have in para 2.

Carla (Legal): I'll email the release text to Maya now and ask for a signed reply. If she wants edits, we can fast-track within 24 hours.

calendarbot: Meeting created: "Voyager publish coordination" Wed 11:00 PT — https://cal.redwood.ai/event/xyz — invites sent to Ana, Julie, Sam, Mike, Carla.

Mike G.: Also flagging ops checklist (small): CDN caching for blog asset, video transcoding for the 30-min excerpt, transcript upload to the CMS. I'll run a quick smoke test after publish.

Ana L.: Adding a tiny release checklist — please confirm status by channels: 
```
- Transcript sign-off: pending (Carla/customer)
- Release permission signed: pending (customer)
- Pull-quote selection: chosen (Maya short quote)
- Screenshots: in progress (Julie)
- Landing page + form: ready (Mike)
- Lead routing workflow: in progress (Mike -> Sam)
- Webinar excerpt editing: queued (Creative)
```

Carla (Legal): Confirmed sent to Maya. I'll update here when signed — should be quick. :thumbsup:

Julie C.: I'll upload final screenshots by EOD Monday and share preview link.

Sam P.: Thanks all — once live I’ll follow up with the AE team and seed the first outreach templates.

Ana L.: Perfect. If we hit Friday approvals we can keep the publish schedule. Appreciate the quick turn around, team :raised_hands:
